statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-40469 is an integer overflow in the result-buffer size calculation of gawk's do_sub() (builtin.c) when '&' is expanded in the replacement text; the CVE describes it as affecting 32-bit builds. Debian's tracker names upstream merge ae1b2d50 as the fix; it brings in commit aa7272a6, which does the calculation in 64 bits and stops with the fatal error '%s: replacement expansion too large' instead of overrunning the buffer (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-40469, https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=ae1b2d508f46913269a9e62aceda3636afe8147b, https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=aa7272a6e1184cdd21ab8f89200219abd8053eda). DHI gawk for Alpine 3.23 packages gawk 5.3.2 and has three builds published by 2026-11-28: 5.3.2-r2, 5.3.2-r3 and 5.3.2-r4, each for x86_64 and aarch64. All six are 64-bit programs. 5.3.2-r4 is the first build that carries a backport of aa7272a6 to 5.3.2: the fatal message is present in usr/bin/gawk of 5.3.2-r4, referenced from do_sub(), and absent from 5.3.2-r2 and 5.3.2-r3, on both architectures. 5.3.2-r3 was built without the backport, so the range conservatively treats both earlier builds as affected.
